messages:
maya: Just now the kitchen microwave belted out what I can only describe as a dramatic opera aria while heating soup. 10/10 theatrics. Anyone in the microwave's fan club? :microphone: :laughing:

tom: Not me — last thing I nuked was a burrito. Could be the microwave's new firmware: 'sitcom mode'.

elia: that's my hummus. I promise i didn't program any arias. :sweat_smile:

sam: We should record it and drop it in #random as 'Microwave: The Musical'.

june: Vote: Should we hold an office microwave karaoke hour tomorrow at 3pm? Reply with :raised_hands: for yes, :wave: for no.

maya: I'll bring a towel for dramatic fainting scenes. :ok_hand:

ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen etiquette — remove food promptly. (added :thumbsup: reaction)

tom: Also, who left the container with foil in there? Dangerous aria activation.

elia: Not me, but if someone did, we should name the microwave. Suggestion: 'Guglielmo' (counts = 1).

sam: I vote 'Guglielmo' :one:

june: Solid. Also, kudos to @maya for delivering the exact vibe in her message. :sparkles:

maya: Thanks! Quick poll tally please — 'Microwave: The Musical' tomorrow 3pm?

tom: Yes

elia: Yes

sam: No (I have meetings) :disappointed:

june: Yes

maya: Tally — 4 yes, 1 no. Microwave expects standing ovation. Meeting invite sent. :tada:
